name: web_search_pipeline_redaction_race_fallback_and_recovery

test_list.description: Run Tavily and SearXNG adapters through bounded loopback HTTP fixtures and WebSearchSource/Sifter::race; observe SDK redaction at the request boundary, one provider failure with failed-open fallback, URL provenance and Untrusted trust, then persist and recover a dropped chunk through the real CAS.

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: Synthetic query containing a canary masked by an SDK Redactor fixture before provider egress.

inputs.name: provider_fixture
inputs.description: Bounded synthetic server returning one provider failure and one search hit, then shutting down.

output_description: Integration evidence for query redaction, real provider dispatch, failure fallback, untrusted URL provenance, CAS persistence and recovery, and fixture server teardown.
